title: DATUM
description: Spatial 3D scene-graph debugger and GPU render-pass profiler featuring a scroll-linked Z-axis pipeline dissection, live frame-budget lab, and schematic SVG fallback.

sections.title: Fixed Instrument Header (`#dt-header`)
sections.summary: Hairline glass bar with the DATUM stacked-slab vector mark, sliding spring-animated active section pill (`Dissection`, `Budget Lab`, `Architecture`, `Access`), live GPU frame-budget badge updating dynamically from the shared state, magnetic `SDK Access` CTA, and an accessible full-screen clip-path drawer on viewports `<= 860px` (`Open menu` / `Close menu`, `Esc` and focus-trap support).

sections.title: Drafting-Grid Hero (`#top`)
sections.summary: Split composition featuring the eyebrow (`SPATIAL GPU PROFILER · WEBGL2 / WEBGPU`), word-masked `<h1>` (*"Every frame, dissected."*), concise lede, dual CTAs (`Dissect 3D Stack`, `Open Budget Lab`), and three `CountUp` telemetry stats (`5` Z-Separated Passes, `444` Draw Batches, `16.6 ms` Frame Lock Target). The right column renders a compact isometric SVG blueprint preview of the five render passes with live budget indicator and clickable pass selector pills.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: 02 // Z-Axis Pipeline Dissection (`#dissection`, Signature Mechanic)
sections.summary: Tall `220svh` asymmetric split layout pairing a sticky 3D stage (`PipelineCanvas` + always-SSR `PipelineSvg` vector fallback) and 5-step vertical rail (`01 Geometry`, `02 Normals`, `03 Shadows`, `04 Bloom/FX`, `05 Composite`) with five inspectable pass cards (`#dt-pass-geometry` through `#dt-pass-composite`). Scrolling through `#dissection` drives CSS variable `--explode` and a shared ref that separates the five 3D render-pass slabs along the Z-axis in real time. Includes interactive HUD toolbar buttons (`Explode Z-Stack` / `Collapse Z-Stack`, `Wireframe`, `Pause Loop` / `Resume Loop`, `Reset View`), drag-to-orbit camera damped with `easeOutExpo`, slab raycast clicking, and keyboard navigation (`ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight`/`ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`, `e`, `w`, `r`, `Home`).
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: 03 // Frame Budget & Bottleneck Lab (`#budget`)
sections.summary: Interactive GPU simulation workbench synchronized with global pipeline state. Features individual `role="switch"` toggles for all five passes, a `Resolution scale` slider (`0.50x` to `2.00x`), target refresh buttons (`60 Hz (16.6 ms)` vs `120 Hz (8.3 ms)`), animated meter bar scaling with Emerald/Amber budget-status pill (`WITHIN ...` vs `OVER BUDGET ...`), draw-call and VRAM totals, detected bottleneck pass, and a 5-tab GLSL shader kernel disassembly inspector (`01`..`05`).
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: 04 // Architecture & SDK (`#architecture`)
sections.summary: Overlapping `#111418` Graphite Ink architectural slab with `Phosphor Signal` accents. Contains a dual-track engineering telemetry marquee (pausing cleanly on hover/focus-within), four capture workflow stages with hairline draw rules, three pointer-reactive `TiltCard` pillars (`Zero-Overhead Hook`, `Deterministic Snapshots`, `WebGL2 & WebGPU`) with neighbor dimming on hover, and live `CountUp` runtime metrics.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: 05 // Early Access & Local Brief (`#access`)
sections.summary: Split layout pairing the live Pinned Pipeline Snapshot summary card with an accessible client-validated `AccessForm` (`WebGL2` / `WebGPU` / `Both` API selector, floating-label fields for `Engineer name`, `Work email`, `Target scene or bottleneck`, invalid shake + inline `grid-template-rows` error expansion). Submitting transitions through a loading morph to a local SVG stamp-drawn receipt (`DT-XXXXXX`) with explicit browser-local disclosure (*"it has not been sent"*) and a working `Download Brief (.txt)` generator.

sections.summary: Dark Graphite Ink closing band with local telemetry disclaimer, section links, DATUM mark, and full-width architectural wordmark lockup.
